function Match() return Scene.FindEntityByName('Match'):GetScript() end
function Board() return Scene.FindEntityByName('Scoreboard'):GetScript() end
function P(peer) return Scene.FindEntityByName('Player' .. peer) end
function E(name) return Scene.FindEntityByName(name) end
function Near(a, b, t) return math.abs(a - b) <= t end
function NearXZ(e, x, z, t) local p = e.WorldPosition return Near(p.x, x, t) and Near(p.z, z, t) end
function At(e) if not e then return 'none' end local p = e.WorldPosition return string.format('%.3f,%.3f,%.3f', p.x, p.y, p.z) end
function Scores() local t = {} for _, r in ipairs(Board().Rows) do t[#t + 1] = r.Peer .. ':' .. r.Score end return table.concat(t, ',') end
function Text(name) return E(name):GetComponent('UIText').Text end
function State()
  local players = {}
  for _, e in ipairs(Scene.GetEntitiesWith('CharacterController')) do players[#players + 1] = e.Name .. '@' .. At(e) end
  table.sort(players)
  return 'scores=' .. Scores() .. ' over=' .. tostring(Board().Over) .. ' message=' .. Board().Message .. ' status=' .. Text('StatusText') .. ' ' .. table.concat(players, ' ')
end
return 'helpers'

local p = P(0)
assert(p and NearXZ(p, -8, -8, 0.01), State())
assert(Network.IsOwner(p) and not Network.IsActive(), State())
assert(Scores() == '0:0' and Text('StatusText'):find('Practice'), State())
assert(Text('ScoreText') == 'You  0', Text('ScoreText'))
return State()

local p = P(0)
assert(NearXZ(p, -5.5, -8, 0.01), State())
local f = p:GetForward()
assert(Near(f.x, 1, 0.001) and Near(f.z, 0, 0.001), 'faces +X')
return State()

local s = P(0):GetScript()
assert(s.TagsRequested == 1 and s.TagsAccepted == 1, s.TagsRequested .. ' ' .. s.TagsAccepted)
s:Tag(0, { 1, 0, 0 }, Network.GetTime())
assert(s.TagsAccepted == 1, 'tagged within the cooldown')
return State()
assert(NearXZ(P(0), 0, -7.917, 0.01), State()) return State()
E('BotA'):GetScript():Respawn() return State()

assert(Scores() == '0:1', State())
assert(NearXZ(E('BotA'), -6, 0, 0.1), 'BotA is back at the start of its lane: ' .. State())
assert(#Scene.FindEntitiesByName('TagBeam') == 1, 'the beam shows')
assert(Text('ScoreText') == 'You  1', Text('ScoreText'))
return State()
assert(#Scene.FindEntitiesByName('TagBeam') == 0, 'the beam is gone') return State()
